title: 第一卷 第20章 漕运商会
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
百乐门，二楼包厢。

    赵海柱光着膀子，脖子上挂着一串大拇指粗的金链子，手里夹着雪茄，唾沫星子横飞。

    “兄弟们！机会来了！”

    “青帮那帮孙子现在就是缩头乌龟，王震一死，陈龙那条过江龙也得掂量掂量。”

    “津门码头这块肥肉，以前咱们只能闻闻味。”

    “现在，该轮到咱们海河帮下嘴了！”

    底下坐着一排海河帮的骨干，一个个听得两眼放光。

    陆川坐在角落里，手里端着茶盏，神色淡然。

    他对这种打打杀杀抢地盘的事兴趣不大。

    但也知道，要想在津门站稳脚跟，光靠拳头不行，还得有钱，有人。

    码头，就是钱！就是人！

    赵海柱说得兴起，猛地一拍桌子，“陆川！你怎么看？”

    我怎么看？

    我坐着看啊！

    陆川心里吐槽，放下茶盏刚想说话。

    “砰！”

    包厢门被人推开。

    一个小弟慌慌张张地跑进来，满头大汗，“帮主！陆爷！外面......外面有个女的，非要见陆爷！”

    赵海柱眉头一皱：“女的？哪来的女的？”

    小弟咽了口唾沫：“说是......说是陆爷的老相好。”

    “噗——”

    旁边正在喝茶的裘然一口茶喷了出来，惊恐地看向陆川。

    陆川也是一愣。

    老相好？

    他这些时日除了杀人就是练功，哪来的老相好？

    “让她进来。”

    陆川沉着脸说道。

    他倒是想看看，这个所谓的老相好到底是什么货色。

    忽悠人都敢忽悠到自己头上了！

    片刻后，一个穿着打补丁蓝布衫的少女走了进来。

    少女约莫十六七岁，身形瘦弱，脸色蜡黄，唯独一双眼睛亮得惊人，透着股机灵劲。

    “川哥。”

    少女看到陆川，眼圈一红，就要跪下。

    陆川起身扶住她：“你是......小手？”

    “是我，川哥。”

    何小手吸了吸鼻子，声音带着哭腔，“我听说你现在是大人物了，我有事......我有事想求你。”

    赵海柱在一旁看得直乐，“哟，陆川，这小姑娘长得挺水灵啊，真是你相好？”

    陆川没理会赵海柱的调侃，拉着何小手走出包厢，“别哭，慢慢说，出什么事了？”

    何小手抹了把眼泪，压低声音道：“川哥，赵扒皮死了。”

    “听说是在红灯照的花馆里，被人乱枪打死的。”

    陆川眼神一凝。

    赵扒皮，津门码头的管事，也是当初陆川当苦力时的顶头上司。

    那人是个吸血鬼，心狠手辣，没想到居然死了。

    “死了就死了，关你什么事？”

    “川哥，赵扒皮一死，码头管事的位置空出来了。”

    何小手急切地说道，“漕运商会要派人来接管，但是按照码头的老规矩，新管事得有一半以上的苦力点头才行。”

    陆川明白了。

    这是权力真空期。

    “你想当管事？”

    陆川问道。

    何小手摇摇头，又点点头：“我想让川哥的人当管事。”

    “漕运商会派来的人是个生面孔，码头上讨生活的苦力日子将会更难过。”

    “川哥，如果你能安排人进去，以后码头的货，还不都是海河帮说了算？”

    陆川心中一动。

    这丫头，看着瘦小，脑子倒是好使。

    这不仅仅是个管事的位置，这是海河帮渗透津门码头的最佳跳板！

    “走，去见帮主。”
content_en:
Paramount, private room on the second floor.

    Zhao Haizhu was shirtless, with a bunch of gold chains as thick as his thumb hanging around his neck. He held a cigar in his hand and saliva was flying everywhere.

    "Brothers! The opportunity has come!"

    "The grandsons of the Qing Gang are just cowering now. Once Wang Zhen dies, Chen Long, the dragon crossing the river, will also have to think about it."

    "In the past, we could only smell this fat piece of meat at Jinmen Wharf."

    "Now, it's our Haihe gang's turn to speak up!"

    Sitting underneath was a row of backbone members of the Haihe Gang, and their eyes lit up as they listened.

    Lu Chuan was sitting in the corner, holding a teacup in his hand and looking indifferent.

    He is not very interested in this kind of fighting and killing to seize territory.

    But I also know that if you want to gain a foothold in Jinmen, you can't just rely on your fists, you must have money and people.

    The dock is money! That’s people!

    Zhao Haizhu got excited and slammed the table, "Lu Chuan! What do you think?"

    What do I think?

    I sit and watch!

    Lu Chuan complained in his heart, put down the tea cup and was about to speak.

    "Bang!"

    The box door was pushed open.

    A younger brother ran in in a panic, sweating profusely, "Gang leader! Master Lu! There... there is a woman outside, and she insists on seeing Master Lu!"

    Zhao Haizhu frowned: "Female? Where did the girl come from?"

    The younger brother swallowed his saliva and said, "Say...she is Mr. Lu's old friend."

    "Pfft——"

    Qiu Ran, who was drinking tea next to him, spit out a mouthful of tea and looked at Lu Chuan in horror.

    Lu Chuan was also stunned.

    Good old friend?

    These days, besides killing people, he is practicing martial arts. How could he have such an old friend?

    "Let her in."

    Lu Chuan said calmly.

    He wanted to see what this so-called old friend was.

    The deceiver dares to deceive himself!

    After a while, a girl wearing a patched blue shirt walked in.

    The girl was about sixteen or seventeen years old, with a thin body and a sallow complexion. Her only pair of eyes were astonishingly bright, exuding intelligence.

    "Brother Chuan."

    When the girl saw Lu Chuan, her eyes turned red and she was about to kneel down.

    Lu Chuan stood up and supported her: "Are you... Little Hand?"

    "It's me, Brother Chuan."

    He Xiaoshou sniffed and said with a cry in his voice, "I heard that you are a big shot now. I have something... I have something to ask you."

    Zhao Haizhu looked on happily, "Hey, Lu Chuan, this little girl is quite pretty. Is she really your crush?"

    Lu Chuan ignored Zhao Haizhu's teasing and walked out of the box holding He Xiao's hand. "Don't cry. Speak slowly. What happened?"

    He Xiaoshou wiped away his tears and lowered his voice: "Brother Chuan, Zhao Bapi is dead."

    "I heard that he was shot to death indiscriminately in a flower shop illuminated by a red light."

    Lu Chuan's eyes narrowed.

    Zhao Bapi, the steward of Jinmen Wharf, was also Lu Chuan’s immediate boss when he was a coolie.

    The man was a vampire, cruel and ruthless, but he didn't expect to die.

    "If you die, you will die. What does it have to do with you?"

    "Brother Chuan, once Zhao Papi dies, the position of dock steward becomes vacant."

    He Xiaoshou said eagerly, "The Water Transport Chamber of Commerce will send someone to take over, but according to the old rules of the dock, the new manager must have more than half of the coolies nodding."

    Lu Chuan understood.

    This is a power vacuum.

    "You want to be a steward?"

    Lu Chuan asked.

    He Xiaoshou shook his head and nodded: "I want Brother Chuan's people to be in charge."

    "The people sent by the Water Transport Chamber of Commerce are new faces, and the coolies making a living on the dock will have a harder time."

    "Brother Chuan, if you can arrange for people to go in, won't the Haihe Gang have the final say on the goods at the dock in the future?"

    Lu Chuan's heart moved.

    This girl looks thin, but she has a good brain.

    This is not just a management position, it is the best springboard for the Haihe Gang to infiltrate Jinmen Wharf!

    "Let's go see the gang leader."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 20 Water Transport Chamber of Commerce
